title: Đọc hồ sơ thí nghiệm mô phỏng về làm mát thụ động

pages: The test compared two unoccupied model boxes in the same courtyard.
The goal was to compare afternoon air temperatures under two roof finishes.

# Ghi chú hiện trường CR-04
